order: Add continuous integration running the review-lane suite, node tests/review-lane.test.js, on Linux, Windows, and macOS across the three supported Node majors, for every push and pull request. Windows is the reason this job exists at all — every field failure in this lane has happened there, the suite exited 0 there even with failing cases, and no session on this repo has a Windows machine. Fix in the same change the two Windows facts the matrix forces open — the runner cannot CreateProcess a .js file, so the tests hand it a .cmd shim, and kill('SIGTERM') there is TerminateProcess, so the honest expectation there is SIGKILL. Every leg of the matrix has to run to completion and report its own result; a red leg may never cancel or hide the others, since seeing which platforms disagree is the whole point. No build, bundle or publish step, and no linter job or new dependency — plain node and plain git.
claims: Order fulfilled exactly as written, with the workflow at .github/workflows/test.yml running node tests/review-lane.test.js on ubuntu-latest, windows-latest and macos-latest across Node 20/22/24, on push, pull_request and manual dispatch. Every matrix leg runs to completion and reports its own result, so one platform's failure cannot cancel or hide the others and a run always shows which platforms disagree. No build, bundle or publish step, no linter job and no new dependency — the job needs only plain node and git. The Windows shim and the SIGKILL expectation are both in the suite.
